task: Find Florida internship programs in the Mayo Clinic College of Medicine and Science.
agent_final_answer:
Navigating within the Mayo Clinic College of Medicine and Science academic programs catalog for Florida yields the following internship programs:

### Internship Programs (Type: Internship)

1. **Administrative Internship Program (Florida)**
   - **School:** Non-Clinical Education
   - **Duration:** 1 semester
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/administrative-internship-program-florida/

2. **Audiology Externship (Florida)**
   - **School:** Health Sciences
   - **Duration:** 1 year
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/audiology-externship-florida/

3. **Biomedical Sciences International Internship (Florida)**
   - **School:** Health Sciences / Non-Clinical Education
   - **Duration:** 1 year
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/biomedical-sciences-international-internship-florida/

4. **Biostatistics and Data Science Internship Program (Florida)**
   - **School:** Non-Clinical Education
   - **Duration:** 1 semester
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/biostatistics-and-data-science-internship-program-florida/

5. **Cardiovascular Medicine Exercise Physiology Internship (Florida)**
   - **School:** Health Sciences
   - **Duration:** 12 weeks
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/cardiovascular-medicine-exercise-physiology-internship-florida/

6. **Cardiovascular Technology Internship (Florida)**
   - **School:** Health Sciences
   - **Duration:** 6 weeks
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/cardiovascular-technology-internship-florida/

7. **Clinical Research Coordinator Internship (Florida)**
   - **School:** Non-Clinical Education
   - **Duration:** 1 semester
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/clinical-research-coordinator-internship-florida/

8. **Clinical Research Internship Study Program (Florida)**
   - **School:** Non-Clinical Education
   - **Duration:** 10 weeks
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/clinical-research-internship-study-program-florida/

9. **Convergence Science Internship: Engineering (Florida)**
   - **School:** Non-Clinical Education
   - **Duration:** 16 weeks
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/convergence-science-internship-engineering-florida/

10. **Dietetic Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences
    - **Duration:** 8 months
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/dietetic-internship-florida/

11. **Echocardiography Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences
    - **Duration:** 6 weeks
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/echocardiography-internship-florida/

12. **FOUR Stroke Education Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Non-Clinical Education
    - **Duration:** 1 year
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/four-stroke-education-internship-florida/

13. **Genetic Counseling Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences
    - **Duration:** 8–10 weeks
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/genetic-counseling-internship-florida/

14. **Health Information Management Internship (Arizona and Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences
    - **Duration:** Varies
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/health-information-management-internship-arizona-and-florida/

15. **Historical Archivist Internship (Florida and Minnesota)**
    - **School:** Non-Clinical Education
    - **Duration:** 1 semester
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/historical-archivist-internship-florida-and-minnesota/

16. **Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences (Specialty: Radiology)
    - **Duration:** 5 months
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/magnetic-resonance-imaging-internship-florida/

17. **Mayo Clinic Physics, Chemistry, and Engineering Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Non-Clinical Education
    - **Duration:** 1 semester
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/mayo-clinic-physics-and-engineering-internship-florida/

18. **Physical or Occupational Therapy Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences
    - **Duration:** 8–12 weeks
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/physical-or-occupational-therapy-internship-florida/

19. **Public Health Internship Program (Florida)**
    - **School:** Non-Clinical Education
    - **Duration:** 1 semester
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/public-health-internship-program-florida/

20. **Social Work Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences
    - **Duration:** 1–2 semesters
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/social-work-internship-florida/

21. **Speech Language Pathology Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences
    - **Duration:** 1 semester
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/speech-pathology-internship-florida/

22. **Speech Pathology Graduate Internship in Voice and Upper Airway (Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences
    - **Duration:** 1–2 semesters
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/speech-pathology-graduate-internship-in-voice-and-upper-airway-florida/

23. **Undergraduate Biomedical Research Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences / Non-Clinical Education
    - **Duration:** 2 semesters
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/non-clinical-education/undergraduate-biomedical-research-internship-florida/

24. **Vascular Interventional Radiologic Technology Internship (Florida)**
    - **School:** Health Sciences
    - **Duration:** 8 months
    - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/health-sciences-education/vascular-interventional-radiologic-technology-internship-florida/

---

### Research Internships / Fellowships (Type: Research Internship/Fellowship)

In addition to the clinical and non-clinical internships above, the Mayo Clinic Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences offers 2 undergraduate research internships/fellowships in Florida:

1. **Nephrology and Urology Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (nuSURF)**
   - **School:** Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences
   - **Duration:** 10 weeks
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/biomedical-research-training/nephrology-and-urology-summer-undergraduate-research-fellowship-nusurf/

2. **Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)**
   - **School:** Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences
   - **Duration:** 10 weeks
   - **Link:** https://college.mayo.edu/academics/biomedical-research-training/summer-undergraduate-research-fellowship-surf/
